products.name: Voltage Pro Carbon
products.desc: Our flagship carbon racer. Real featherweight knit shell over a full-length carbon plate and dual-density VOLTFOAM™ midsole. A bold race-day profile, designed to look as fast as it feels.

products.name: Apex 01 Racer
products.desc: Race-day geometry with a rocker that keeps you rolling forward. Minimal mass, maximum aggression. Built for race-day intent.

products.name: Monolith High
products.desc: A sculpted high-top built from full-grain leather with a cushioned collar. Quiet luxury, loud silhouette.

products.name: Strike Court Lo
products.desc: Herringbone traction, locked-in ankle collar and an explosive first step. Built for blacktop and hardwood.

products.name: Inferno Tilt Carbon
products.desc: 300 numbered pairs. Reflective cage, glow outsole and a carbon plate tuned for explosive toe-off. Reflective details with a high-visibility finish.

products.name: Nebula Runner
products.desc: Maximum cushion, maximum statement. Triple-stacked foam and a glacier-soft upper that floats above the pavement.

products.name: Shadow Knit
products.desc: A stealth everyday silhouette in matte knit with a sock-like fit. Disappears into any fit — until it hits the light.

products.name: Retro 85 Carbon
products.desc: The 1985 legend, remastered with modern cushioning. Vintage shape, full-grain upper, zero nostalgia fatigue.

texts.hero.sub: Sculpted carbon propulsion. Knitted precision uppers. Dual-density VOLTFOAM™ tuned in the lab and proven on concrete. Built for athletes who never turn the volume down.
texts.sections.collectionSub: {{stylesLive}} silhouettes. Filter by discipline, inspect product details, and preview a pair in seconds.
texts.sections.techSub: {{labIterationYears}} years of lab iteration, {{fieldTestKm}} kilometres of field testing and a single target: return more energy than anything you've ever worn.
texts.techFeatures.0.title: Carbon propulsion plate
texts.techFeatures.0.body: A full-length aerospace carbon plate suspended between dual-density foams. It stores and releases {{energyReturnPercent}}% of the energy you put into the ground.
texts.techFeatures.1.title: Precision knit shell
texts.techFeatures.1.body: A single-piece precision knit with zoned breathability — reinforced where you push, open where you overheat. No seams, no pressure points.
texts.techFeatures.2.title: Impact armour foam
texts.techFeatures.2.body: Dual-density VOLTFOAM™ absorbs three times the impact of standard EVA while staying responsive at tempo. Land soft. Launch violently.
texts.sections.perfSub: Independent testing against the previous generation, averaged across {{testedAthletes}} athletes over half-marathon distance.
